title: Choose the visual world for AI System Design
question: The roll assigned Computation Pad. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Computation Pad
options.lineage: engineering computation paper and lab notebooks
options.thesis: Every lesson is a dated, numbered worksheet; every lab is a worked problem with the result boxed.
options.viewport: Home is the pad's cover page: a header strip with course name, sheet count and your next sheet; the six weeks listed as numbered sheet ranges. A lesson opens with a worksheet header (sheet 14 of 37, time, checked date) and a calm reading column on near-white, with the grid living only in the frame and margins.
options.risk: Grid paper can turn into a gimmick or visual noise behind text if it reaches the reading column.

raised.raise: The reading column holds a fixed measure of about 66 characters; navigation lives in the margin, never inside the text.
Progress state is carried by mark shape (open box, ticked box, boxed result), never by colour alone.
Nothing moves behind the text while you read; motion is limited to marks being made.
Diagrams are numbered as figures (Fig. 3.2) and referenced from the text, like plates.
Flat inks only: no gradients, glows or shadows anywhere.

options.label: Request for Comments
options.thesis: The course as a numbered standards series: each lesson an RFC with sections, requirement keywords and references.
options.viewport: A lesson opens with an RFC-style header block (number, category, date) and a numbered table of contents; design rules read as MUST and SHOULD statements.
options.risk: Familiar to engineers and close to the docs-site default; monospace body text tires readers over long lessons.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: Every claim in the course carries its custody: source, check date, and revision, visible on a ribbon.
options.viewport: Each lesson shows a ribbon of its sources and fact-check revisions beside the text.
options.case: Fuses partly: sourced, fact-checked numbers are the course's real differentiator; engineers do not identify with museum records.
options.risk: Buff ground drifts toward the cream-paper default.

options.label: Literary quarterly interior
options.thesis: Leaves of text on a deep blue ground under raking light.
options.viewport: Cream leaves on oltremare with a giant vermilion numeral.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a literary object, not an engineer's.
options.kept: A fixed reading measure; navigation in the margin.

options.label: Emission-line rail
options.thesis: Every destination a tick on one calibrated rail.
options.viewport: A rail of hairlines with one open plate.
options.case: Fuses poorly: elegant but abstract wayfinding.
options.kept: State carried by mark shape, not colour.

options.label: Cracktro scroller
options.thesis: Bitmap text over drifting dust fields.
options.viewport: One still line of text over drifting layers.
options.case: Fuses poorly: bitmap type and drift fight long reading.

options.label: Curved-crease shell
options.thesis: One crease turns a flat sheet into structure.
options.viewport: A disc rising along one arc.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to the course.

options.label: WPA park poster
options.thesis: Flat-ink landscapes with one imperative in block caps.
options.viewport: A layered landscape and a caption bar.
options.case: Fuses poorly: scenery has nothing to show for a technical course.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.viewport: Left navigation, centred article, on-this-page rail, the arrangement every docs reader expects.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other course and docs site by design.
